PortfolioSettings.title: PortfolioSettings
PortfolioSettings.description: Global portfolio protection settings and default theme configuration managed exclusively by the portfolio admin.

exportLockEnabled.description: Whether file downloads and compiled token exports are locked for unapproved viewers.

copyLockEnabled.description: Whether source code and token copy buttons are locked for unapproved viewers.

allowAccessRequests.description: Whether signed-in visitors may submit export access requests.

ownerDisplayName.description: Display name of the portfolio owner shown in protection notices.

lockMessage.description: Custom notice displayed to visitors on locked export panels.

defaultPresetName.description: Published default colour theme preset name.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last settings update.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who updated the settings.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator directory record conferring admin privileges.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

grantedBy.description: UID of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin status was recorded.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private authenticated visitor profile containing PII, strictly readable only by the owner or portfolio admin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user's email address has been verified.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of first sign-in.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent sign-in.

ExportApproval.title: ExportApproval
ExportApproval.description: Admin-managed allowlist record granting a specific authenticated user permission to download and copy design tokens.

uid.description: Approved user UID matching the document ID.

approvedBy.description: UID of the admin who approved export access.

note.description: Optional admin note describing the approval context.

grantedAt.description: Server timestamp when export permission was granted.

AccessRequest.title: AccessRequest
AccessRequest.description: Export access request submitted by a verified signed-in portfolio visitor awaiting admin review.

uid.description: Requester UID matching the document ID.

reason.description: Reason for requesting export or download access.

provider.description: Authentication provider used by the requester.

status.description: Review status of the export request.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the request was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last status or detail update.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Append-only security and export activity log readable exclusively by the portfolio admin.

actorUid.description: UID of the authenticated user triggering the event.

actorEmail.description: Email of the user triggering the event.

target.description: Export target, file name, or affected user.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of the event.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Stores the global portfolio lock configuration at /settings/portfolio.

/admins/{uid}.description: Trusted administrator lookup documents keyed by UID.

/users/{uid}.description: Private user profile documents containing PII, restricted to owner and admin.

/exportApprovals/{uid}.description: Admin-managed export allowlist keyed by user UID.

/accessRequests/{uid}.description: Export access requests submitted by verified visitors, keyed by requester UID.

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Append-only export and security audit logs readable only by admin.
